sources.title: ConvNeXt - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: ConvNeXt is a modern convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture that reimagines classic CNNs by integrating successful design elements from Vision Transformers (ViTs). Developed by Facebook AI Research, ConvNeXt achieves state-of-the-art performance on image recognition tasks while maintaining the efficiency and scalability of CNNs.

sources.title: ConvNeXt — Torchvision main documentation
sources.snippet: ConvNeXt ¶ The ConvNeXt model is based on the A ConvNet for the 2020s paper. Model builders ¶ The following model builders can be used to instantiate a ConvNeXt model, with or without pre-trained weights. All the model builders internally rely on the torchvision.models.convnext.ConvNeXt base class. Please refer to the source code for more details about this class.
